Lovely atmosphere, great food, impressive winelist.
Feb 2024 • Couples
I am not a foodie but a bit of a tartar nerd. My partner is interested in wine. I must admit, the tartar served at MAD was propably the best I’ve ever had (“probably the best tartar in the world” to use a danish Carlsberg classic). My partner was equally impressed by the winelist which offered many small treasures by the glass. I stuck to my prosecco through the night, and it proved an exellent backdrop to the rest of the menu as well. We have loved every crumb of Vietnamese food on our way, so if there ever was a place worthy of breaking our cuisine ‘fast’ with something more familiar, MAD was the place. Lovely ambience, great staff and wonderful story of a danish couple settling across the globe to share their love for food, craft and a new country.

Completely disappointed
Sep 2022 • Friends
After a friend tell me good stuff about this place, I went to check it out with my girlfriend and her friend.

It was lunch time, the place was empty as a ghost city, which makes me think, "what is going on"?

The waitress (all on the mobile), look like does not care much about doing a good service.

But the worse was yet to come: the food!

I order pork chop with barley risotto, the risotto (they must change the name, its an insult call that thing a risotto), it was sour as hell, with a disgusting fatty flavour that makes me sent it back to the kitchen. 

Waitress came back and said they would do a new one. Afraid of new disaster I ask to change for mashed potato. When it gets back the mashed potato was very ok if I was having a lunch in a hospital, no flavour at all and full of potato lumps.

Well the pork was very over cooked and the sauce oily , fatty, depressed horrible.

This restaurant to be ok need to improve a lot.

Only positive stuff is the ambience, but I have been much happier eating phô or Bun Cha in many sidewalks of Saigo...

From 1 to 10 I give 1,5 to this 'madness' lunch...

Not the first time but definitely the last time
Oct 2020
My family had 4 people and none of our dishes was well made. The burger was ordered medium rare but turned out nearly well done. The fries were too salty, same as the pasta. The tuna salad seemed to have an unfortunate event of pepper overdose, I couldn't taste tuna anymore. Most disappointing of all, when I shared the feedbacks with the waiter, he had no action towards it besides awkwardly saying sorry. I even asked him at the end if he shared my feedback with the manager, giving a hint of a proper way of handling customer complaint, but he answered with an annoying attitude. I didn't see the value of what we paid for at all at this restaurant when service level is somewhat less than a fast food restaurant. Extremely disappointed
